source_snapshot.procedure: Select front-side disks and run SST stress for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: Repeats the four procedure actions; no expected outcome or threshold.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because targets, workload semantics, acceptance oracle and recovery inputs are absent.

old_problem: The row names every front storage bay but neither identifies safe targets nor defines the workload or any authoritative PASS result.
disposition_reason: ED-04 prohibits guessing or writing protected storage; ED-15 prohibits PASS without thresholds. Unlike a mere runtime IP/BDF, the absent destructive policy and criteria determine the core command semantics, data risk and verdict, so parameterization cannot yet make this executable.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row38 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3076 and actual next pending row39/history3077 were read.
Criteria are procedural duplicates, not an acceptance oracle.
All-front-bay coverage needs immutable slot-to-serial/WWN/namespace identity and boot/mount/RAID/data exclusions.
Read/write mix, dataset, duration/concurrency, endurance authorization and per-device integrity/performance/error limits are inseparable from safety and verdict.
No storage command or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: All front storage 12-hour stress at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: After an approved storage contract exists, verify every intended front-bay device under cold/high-rail conditions without data, media, link, reset or platform failure.
required_package: Signed bay/serial/WWN/namespace map and protected-target exclusions
Approved SST workload and destructive-data policy
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RUN. First approve immutable targets, exclusions, exact read/write workload, data authorization, measurable per-device criteria and recovery; then qualified staff may execute the 12-hour cold/high-rail profile.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be authoritatively stated until the project supplies per-device integrity, media/link/reset, performance and thermal limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is permitted from elapsed time, SST exit or clean-looking logs because the Master criteria contain no expected result. Each mapped bay needs a signed oracle.
safety_gate: Never infer a disk from /dev naming
Require write authorization, backup/disposability and endurance approval
Preserve logs; prevent condensation/rail overshoot; no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: Undefined until owners provide workload-specific stop, data recovery/restore, device quarantine, dry warm-up and nominal-restoration procedures; this missing recovery keeps the case blocked.

source_conflict.reason: Criteria repeat actions while the item claims all-storage validation, leaving no acceptance result.

blocked.reason: Core target safety, workload meaning, authoritative oracle and recovery remain absent.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Provide the complete storage identity/exclusion/workload/oracle/recovery contract plus environmental limits.
pending.owner: Storage, data, platform margin and lab owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the full per-bay storage contract and recovery, not merely device numbers.
